SELECT rr.*,u.display_name engineer_name FROM repair_record rr JOIN system_user u ON u.user_id=rr.engineer_id WHERE rr.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY rr.created_at
SELECT l.*,u.display_name operator_name FROM order_status_log l JOIN system_user u ON u.user_id=l.operator_id WHERE l.order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY l.created_at
